ENGINE 4.5 / ADAPTIVE REALISM
Five live levels: OFF, LOW, BALANCED, HIGH, INSANE.
Adaptive Realism is UNCANNY-native and vendor-neutral; it does not require DLSS 5, CUDA or Tensor Cores.
Capability tiers: A = trustworthy depth + native motion; B = trustworthy depth + UNCANNY optical flow; C = trustworthy depth only; D = no trustworthy depth and uses tonal/spatial fallback only.
D3D11 currently has the strongest generic depth-aware Adaptive Realism route. D3D12, D3D10 and D3D9 reduce capability when trustworthy generic scene depth is unavailable.
Motion Guard and Ghosting Guard remain authoritative. X2.5 uses the lowest temporal-history weight and is the clean-motion target.
UNCANNY PASSES and DLSS 5 PASSES are separate controls. ENABLE UNCANNY OFF remains the master bypass.

PRESERVED SYSTEMS
Launcher/scanner, install/update/rollback, PCSX2 handling, Control Deck, REVENANT, Hotfix 11/12 compatibility work, D3D9/10/11/12 routes, provider diagnostics and DLSS 5 cooperation remain present.

SECURITY / PACKAGE
Public ZIP contains no engine source, debug symbols, nested development archives or internal test executables.
Restricted third-party shader source/package audit: PASS.
Microsoft Defender scan of extracted final Engine 4.5 package: 0 detections.
Microsoft Defender scan of completed Engine 4.5 ZIP: 0 detections.
No paid/restricted Marty McFly / Pascal Gilcher shader source or binaries are bundled.

SOURCE POLICY
The full engineering source is private. The public repository contains docs and release/support information. Public release ZIPs contain compiled runtime files and documentation, not the private C/C++/HLSL development workspace.

STATUS / LIMITATIONS
Adaptive Realism itself is cross-vendor, but the optional DLSS 5 route is NVIDIA-specific.
D3D11 is currently the strongest Adaptive Realism path. D3D12/D3D9 use honest reduced fallbacks where generic scene depth is unavailable. Vulkan/OpenGL are not at DirectX parity. REVENANT native-game replacement remains experimental.
Build/CI verification does not replace real-game visual/performance acceptance on specific GPUs and titles.
